{{Weapon infobox | prefix = selectable | type = Sword | skin = Wages of Stars (skin) | set = Legendary weapons | level = 80 | id = 110020 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | gallery1-text = Wielded. | gallery2 = Wages of Stars stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | requires = voe }} [[Wages of Stars]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] [[sword]] that was introduced with the [[release]] [[Code of Creation]].[[Media:Code of Creation.jpg|Code of Creation promo]] == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|Fixing the deepest flaw within existence bears an enormous cost, one that requires the most focused of minds, the strongest of wills, and paid for in wages of stars.}} == Acquisition == {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Fledgling Constellation | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of the Tenebral Ward | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Reality | ingredient4 = 1 Mystic Tribute }} == Graphics == Wages of Stars is a cosmic-themed weapon with a celestial appearance. ;Aura * The wielder's hand is covered in a purple field of stars. ;Draw/stow effects * When drawing, bright white sparkles appear around the user and fly outwards. Constellation-like patterns appear in the air around them, and disappear shortly after. * When stowing, the sword disappears from the user's side in a flash of golden sparkles. The hilt reappears in the air next to them, and shortly thereafter forms the blade as well. * When stowed, Wages of Stars floats at the user's side. A copy floats at each side if two Wages of Stars are equipped. ;Footfalls * The user leaves behind golden, starry footfalls. ;Finisher effect * An astral projection of [[the All]] appears above a slain target and bombards them with a beam of light. A constellation in the form of a dragon's head roars above the projection as two manta rays circle it, before disappearing. ;Skill effects * Projectile attacks take one of three random forms: a celestial manta ray, multiple starry swords, or a shining orb of starlight. * In general, the weapon's form changes depending on the skill animation (e.g. slashing, stabbing, spinning, smashing, or leaping). ** Skills that use a ''chanting'' animation (some healing, utility e.g. [[signet]]s, and other) display a projection of the All in front of the character. ** Skills that use a ''guarding'' animation transform the weapon into a turtle. ** Skills that use a ''grabbing'' or ''leaping'' animation transform the weapon into a claw. ** Skills that use a ''slashing'' animation transform the weapon into a khopesh, usually on the first skill chain. ** Skills that use a ''smashing'' or ''countering'' animation transform the weapon into a fist, usually on the second skill chain. ** Skills that use a ''stabbing'' animation the weapon cause five precursor swords to appear along the blade. ** Skills that use a ''spinning'' animation transform the weapon into a manta ray. ** Skills that use a ''raising'' animation transform the weapon into a dragon head. ** Skills that use an ''empowering'' animation transform the weapon into a wing. ** Skills that use an ''offhand slashing'' animation transform the weapon into a harpoon. * Some of these effects are triggered by skills from the other weapon equipped alongside this sword. * A skill may trigger multiple forms if its animation consists of multiple actions. * The evolution skill lists are as follows: {{Collapsible section|{{g}} [[Guardian]]|style=max-width: 68em;| * {{skill icon|Sword Arc}}: the end of the blade takes on the shape of a khopesh facing in the swing's direction. * {{skill icon|Sword Wave}}: five additional blades appear around it. * {{skill icon|Zealot's Defense}}: the end of the blade takes on the shape of a khopesh facing in the swing's direction.
